# Holly of Payroll (`holly-of-payroll`)

Payroll audit for nursing homes before the payroll is released: missing punches, paid hours that differ from the time clock, overtime under the 40-hour or 8/80 rule, shift differentials left out of the overtime rate, garnishments over the limit and terminated staff still paid. Employee names and ids are masked before results reach the model.

**Holly never releases, changes or voids a payroll.**

Evergreen ver 1 · Payroll and staffing · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · resident and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`evergreen-core`](../evergreen-core)

```bash
npx -y holly-of-payroll demo
npx -y holly-of-payroll mcp --root ./facility-files
```

## What the sample data shows

A fictional Cedar Hollow payroll for 1 to 14 March 2026 (workweeks start Sunday). Planted:

- E101: 42.5 hours a week, with 5 overtime hours paid correctly. The 420 creditor garnishment is over the 25% limit of 345.
- E102: an RN on 8/80, with 24 daily overtime hours paid. The 288 shift differential was left out of the overtime rate.
- E103: paid 76 hours with 72 on the clock. The child support order is within the 50% limit.
- E104: a missing clock-out on 9 March.
- E105: terminated 27 February and still paid.
- E106: worked 48 hours in week one and was paid no overtime.

Employee names and ids are in [`phi-canaries.json`](fixtures/phi-canaries.json); they must never reach the model. [`rules-typo.json`](fixtures/rules-typo.json) misspells a setting, so the check refuses it.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `holly_check` | Compare the payroll register with the time clock before payroll is released. | runs |
| `holly_write_report` | Write holly-payroll-audit.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and holly-payroll-audit.html into out_dir (default evergreen-out/holly). | runs |
| `holly_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `holly_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `holly_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `holly_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `payroll_release` | Holly never releases, changes or voids a payroll. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `holly_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `punches` (required) | Time clock punches under --root: employee, date, in, out |
| `register` (required) | Payroll register under --root: employee, pay date, period, regular and overtime hours, rate, shift differential pay, overtime pay, gross, garnishment, garnishment type, disposable earnings |
| `employees` | Optional employee file under --root: employee, termination date, overtime rule (40 or 8/80) |
| `rules` | Optional rules JSON: week_start, hours_tolerance, garnish_pct, support_pct, default_ot_rule |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold resident or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx holly-of-payroll inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Time clock punches (`punches`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `employee_id` | text (masked) | Employee ID, Employee #, Emp ID, Badge, File Number, Employee Number |
| `employee_name` | text (masked) | Employee, Employee Name, Name, Worker |
| `date` (required) | date | Date, Work Date, Shift Date, Punch Date |
| `in` | text | In, Time In, Clock In, Punch In, Start |
| `out` | text | Out, Time Out, Clock Out, Punch Out, End |

### Payroll register (`register`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `employee_id` | text (masked) | Employee ID, Employee #, Emp ID, Badge, File Number, Employee Number |
| `employee_name` | text (masked) | Employee, Employee Name, Name, Worker |
| `pay_date` | date | Pay Date, Check Date |
| `period_start` | date | Period Start, Pay Period Start, Begin |
| `period_end` | date | Period End, Pay Period End, End |
| `regular_hours` | number | Regular Hours, Reg Hours, REG |
| `ot_hours` | number | OT Hours, Overtime Hours, OT |
| `rate` | amount | Rate, Base Rate, Hourly Rate, Pay Rate |
| `diff_pay` | amount | Differential, Shift Diff, Diff Pay, Shift Differential |
| `ot_pay` | amount | OT Pay, Overtime Pay, OT Earnings |
| `gross` | amount | Gross, Gross Pay, Total Earnings |
| `garnishment` | amount | Garnishment, Garnish, Wage Garnishment |
| `garnishment_type` | text | Garnishment Type, Garnish Type, Order Type |
| `disposable` | amount | Disposable, Disposable Earnings |

### Employee file (`employees`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `employee_id` | text (masked) | Employee ID, Employee #, Emp ID, Badge, File Number, Employee Number |
| `employee_name` | text (masked) | Employee, Employee Name, Name, Worker |
| `terminated_on` | date | Terminated, Termination Date, Term Date |
| `ot_rule` | text | OT Rule, Overtime Rule, OT Method |

## Settings file (`holly_rules`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `week_start` | First day of the workweek, 0 = Sunday (default 0) |
| `hours_tolerance` | Allowed difference between paid and punched hours (default 0.25) |
| `garnish_pct` | Limit for ordinary garnishments, percent of disposable earnings (default 25; your state may be lower) |
| `support_pct` | Limit for support orders (default 50; can be up to 65 by federal law depending on the order) |
| `default_ot_rule` | Overtime rule when the employee file does not say (default 40) |

## Memory

`holly_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `holly_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|
| `payroll_note` | is shown with results. It never changes a check. |

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `evergreen-core` and `remedy-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "holly-of-payroll": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "holly-of-payroll",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/facility-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add holly-of-payroll -- npx -y holly-of-payroll mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
holly-of-payroll tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
holly-of-payroll sources               # the columns each input is read from
holly-of-payroll inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
holly-of-payroll call holly_check '{"punches":"<punches>","register":"<register>"}'
holly-of-payroll eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
holly-of-payroll demo
```

## Resident and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: resident and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, a payer portal, a bank, a state Medicaid portal or a payroll system.
- Medicare, Medicaid and payroll rules are summarised from public material as of 2026 and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, payroll or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, tax, accounting, clinical, reimbursement or HIPAA advice. A person decides what to bill, pay, appeal, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
